copy.curiosityHook: Once the lethal tape begins to play, what ominous forces are awakened, and can the countdown be stopped before it claims another life?
copy.description: After a mysterious videotape is linked to multiple sudden deaths, an inquisitive journalist tracks down the recording and watches it herself, triggering a lethal chain of events.
copy.vibeSummary: A slow, deliberate build of dread and suspense best faced with focused, solitary attention.
copy.whyWatch: Director Hideo Nakata crafts an unsettling Japanese horror thriller that trades shock tactics for slow-burning dread and deliberate investigative tension.
